description.value: You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (4th): You can feed 12 Medium creatures.

Heightened (6th): You can feed 50 Medium creatures.

Heightened (8th): You can feed 200 Medium creatures.
